definitions.full: H5510. Sivan סִיוָן proper name of 3rd month, Siwan = May-June (loan-word from Assyrian -Babylonian Simânu , compare Schr COT Neh 1:1 Muss-Arn JRL xi (1892), 82 ff. ; Palmyrene סיון Lzb 328 Cook 84 ); — ס הוּאתֹֿדֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישֹׁי ׳בַּחֹדֶשׁ Est 8:9 .

occurrences.englishText: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.
